claim: The proxy has no shader-creation signal: settle is scene ready (battle_deploy, battle, naval or campaign) plus 30 presented frames plus the scene unchanged for 2000 ms (adapter ctl.settle). Measured on the PC: the settle ends about 2.7 s after the load answer (300 to 960 frames at 1920x1080), and a shot right after it differs from one 10 s later by 2.56/255, the noise floor of animation and JPEG; the measured baseline shots after it repeat across launches within 1.0 to 4.5 (battles)
